method: Moved verbatim from checkwash/benchmarks/adjudication-2026-08-26b.json. the D-051 module-constants arm adds exactly one block to the sweep (41 -> 42, click 5989375dc3, gone 0). The 41 prior verdicts are carried verbatim from adjudication-2026-08-26.json; the one new block was adjudicated by the maintainer single-pass against the real diff - weaker independence than the promotion round's two blind raters, noted per the 2026-08-03 precedent for its five maintainer-judged verdicts. Pre-registration (P1-P4, scratchpad preregister-module-constants) held on every line: zero departures, one new block inside the five-of-1800 budget, arms case-for-case unmoved.

verdicts.reason: "separate copy per call" moves `original.copy()` from decoration time into the wrapper in src/flask/ctx.py, and the same diff deletes the greenlet dependency from pyproject.toml while replacing both `TestGreenletContextCopying` tests with `test_copy_context_thread`, which drives `copy_current_request_context` across a 10-item ThreadPoolExecutor map and asserts the same current_app/path/args/session invariants — equivalent (arguably stronger) coverage added in the same diff.

"remove egg test" deletes test_egg_installed_paths and the install_egg fixture (37 lines of conftest) while the only production change in src/flask/scaffold.py is a comment edit ('points to the .egg or .zip file' -> 'points to the .zip file'); the loader.archive branch it exercised still exists and nothing in this diff replaces the coverage. Deleting for environmental reasons (Python 3.12 drops setuptools) is exactly the allowlist case.

"push preserved contexts in correct order" changes src/flask/testing.py from `while self._new_contexts: cm = self._new_contexts.pop()` to a forward `for cm in self._new_contexts`, and the flagged test is renamed test_redirect_keep_session -> test_redirect_session in the same diff, rewritten to assert the newly-correct ordering (session["redirect"] and session["target"] both True after follow_redirects) rather than removed.

The commit is exactly "remove unicode host test" — a single file, 21 pure deletions of `test_environ_for_valid_idna_completes`, with no production change and no replacement test anywhere in the diff. Oracle coverage for IDNA HTTP_HOST handling drops with nothing in this diff compensating, so blocking is greenwash doing its documented job and a reviewer would allowlist it.

"remove werkzeug host tests" is 48 pure deletions in one test file, no production change, no replacement anywhere in the diff. The coverage moved to the upstream werkzeug project, which no diff analyser can see. Blocking is the documented behaviour; a reviewer allowlists it.

"revert cli test change" is test-only and undoes the strengthening from e82db2c: `assert "HEAD" not in output` plus `assert "OPTIONS" not in output` collapse back to the single narrower `assert "GET, HEAD, OPTIONS, POST" not in output`, and the `_automatic_options` filter in test_all_urls is dropped too. No production file is touched and nothing in this diff restores the lost coverage.

"merge app and request context" is a large honest refactor: the request context variable folds into _cv_app, so tests/test_testing.py rewrites `assert _cv_request.get(None) is req_ctx` to `assert _cv_app.get(None) is req_ctx` (same identity check against the renamed internal) and the autouse leak fixture rewrites `assert leaks == []` to `assert not leaks` (equivalent for a list). No oracle coverage is lost. Newly blocked in v0.1.27: the A5-x fixture channel makes the conftest autouse assert part of each unit's reachable set, so its rewrite became visible and reads as a replacement greenwash cannot verify equivalent — the same equivalent-rewrite family (THREATMODEL #7) as the httpx public-API cluster. Two findings on test_client_pop_all_preserved after the one-finding-per-origin dedupe; before it, the same commit produced twenty-four.
